note: Adding and subtracting on a place-value chart with trades: development cases for need 35P-07, 2026-11-25, written from blueprint.json in this folder (rows A1-A6). Used for design and tuning; the scoring set is separate, written later by a fresh agent from the blueprint alone, sealed. Never taken from the question set. PT-01 to PT-15 are cases this need serves (8 en-US, 7 zh-CN; 7 add, 8 subtract; 11 whole numbers, 4 decimals): expect.numbers are the two numbers as plain decimal strings, expect.result the answer. PT-16 to PT-21 are near misses that belong to other needs (expect.need names it): this need's component must not be used (forbid names the component's recipe, place_value_trade (OLL decision 0026)). Chinese cases use 进位/退位, 满十进一/退一作十, as Chinese learners say them.
